changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwhospitalizations AS SELECT h.id, h.patient_id, h.facility, h.reason, h.admission_type, h.date_of_admission, h.length_of_stay_days, h.outcomes, h.medical_interventions_performed, h.created_by, h.created_date, h.last_modified_by, h.last_modified_date, h.status, h.cancelled_by, h.cancelled_date, h.cancellation_reason FROM public.hospitalizations h;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwhospitalizations TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwhospitalizations FROM report_user;
